fine.name: Diffusion Transformer Quantization and Sparsity
fine.one_line: These papers speed up image and video diffusion transformers with post-training or quantization-aware quantization and trainable sparse attention.

fine.name: LLM Benchmarking and LLM-as-a-Judge
fine.one_line: These papers study how LLMs are evaluated, covering benchmark design and reliability, judge bias, leaderboard rankings and AI peer review.

fine.name: Long-Context Sparse and Linear Attention
fine.one_line: These papers make long-context language models efficient through sparse attention, linear RNNs and state-space models, and positional encodings that extend context length.

fine.name: Reward Models and Human Behavior Modeling
fine.one_line: These papers mix reward and process-reward modeling for LLMs, including reward hacking, with computational models of human and animal decision-making behavior.

fine.name: Transformer Mechanisms and Expressivity Theory
fine.one_line: These papers analyze how transformers compute, covering in-context learning theory, looped transformers, attention sinks, massive activations and length generalization.

fine.name: LLM Knowledge Editing and Forgetting
fine.one_line: These papers update or edit the factual knowledge stored in LLMs and study the forgetting and memorization that happen during continual post-training.

fine.name: Class-Incremental Continual Learning
fine.one_line: These papers learn new classes or tasks one after another without forgetting old ones, often with LoRA adapters, merging or optimizers built for stability and plasticity.

fine.name: Controllable Video Generation and Editing
fine.one_line: These papers generate and edit videos with control over subjects, motion, identity and lighting, often by turning image editors into video editors.

fine.name: 3D Gaussian Splatting
fine.one_line: These papers improve 3D Gaussian splatting and neural rendering for novel view synthesis, including feed-forward reconstruction, compression and densification.

fine.name: LLM Safety Alignment and Jailbreaks
fine.one_line: These papers study how safety alignment and refusal behavior in LLMs and multimodal models hold up, break under jailbreaks or fine-tuning, and can be made more robust.

fine.name: Visual Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs
fine.one_line: These papers improve and diagnose how vision-language models reason over images, including latent visual reasoning, visual chain-of-thought and grounding.

fine.name: KV Cache Compression and Eviction
fine.one_line: These papers shrink the memory cost of LLM inference by evicting, quantizing, pruning or reusing key-value cache entries.

fine.name: Diffusion Language Models Decoding
fine.one_line: These papers develop masked and discrete diffusion language models, focusing on parallel decoding, speculative sampling, unmasking strategies and RL post-training.

fine.name: Optimal Transport Algorithms and Theory
fine.one_line: These papers propose solvers and estimation theory for optimal transport, including Gromov-Wasserstein, sliced, unbalanced and barycenter problems.

fine.name: Diffusion Sampling and MCMC Samplers
fine.one_line: These papers design and analyze samplers built on diffusion models, Langevin dynamics and sequential Monte Carlo, including posterior sampling for inverse problems.

fine.name: Goal-Conditioned RL and Task Specifications
fine.one_line: These papers train RL agents to reach goals or satisfy formal task specifications such as temporal logic and reward machines, often offline and with subgoal planning.

fine.name: Learning with Noisy and Weak Labels
fine.one_line: These papers handle imperfect supervision such as label noise, partial and positive-unlabeled labels, class imbalance and active learning, along with surrogate-loss theory.

fine.name: Dexterous and Humanoid Robot Manipulation
fine.one_line: These papers learn dexterous hand-object interaction, humanoid loco-manipulation and contact-rich control, often from egocentric human videos and tactile or force signals.

fine.name: RL Theory for MDPs
fine.one_line: These papers prove convergence and sample-complexity results for policy gradient, value iteration and off-policy evaluation in discounted and average-reward MDPs.

fine.name: Cooperative Multi-Agent RL
fine.one_line: These papers train teams of agents to coordinate and explore in cooperative or mixed-motive multi-agent reinforcement learning and Markov games.

fine.name: Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents
fine.one_line: These papers build and benchmark memory systems that let LLM agents store, retrieve and update past experience over long dialogues and tasks.

fine.name: Multimodal Agent Benchmarks and Search
fine.one_line: These papers evaluate and train multimodal LLM agents for web search, deep research, tool use and embodied decision-making, mostly through new benchmarks.

fine.name: Anomaly Detection Across Modalities
fine.one_line: These papers detect anomalies in industrial images, time series, graphs, video and audio, including zero-shot and few-shot settings.

fine.name: Weather, Climate and Air Quality Forecasting
fine.one_line: These papers forecast weather, air quality, cyclones and other environmental and energy quantities with ML models and new benchmarks.

fine.name: Efficient High-Resolution Image Diffusion
fine.one_line: These papers make image diffusion models faster and higher-resolution through feature caching, few-step distillation, pixel-space diffusion and diffusion-based super-resolution.

fine.name: Multimodal Fusion and Missing Modalities
fine.one_line: These papers study how multimodal models combine modalities, addressing modality imbalance, missing modalities, cross-modal alignment and synergy.

fine.name: Action-Conditioned Video World Models
fine.one_line: These papers build interactive, action-conditioned video world models for robots, games and embodied agents, sometimes combined with vision-language-action policies.

fine.name: Federated Learning under Heterogeneity
fine.one_line: These papers train models across distributed clients with non-IID data, covering aggregation, personalization, federated LoRA, robustness and privacy.

fine.name: Domain Adaptation and Generalization
fine.one_line: These papers transfer models across distribution shifts through unsupervised, source-free and graph domain adaptation and domain generalization.

fine.name: Treatment Effect Estimation and Causal Inference
fine.one_line: These papers estimate heterogeneous and average treatment effects and counterfactual outcomes from observational, experimental and survival data.

fine.name: Multi-Armed and Contextual Bandits
fine.one_line: Regret bounds and algorithms for stochastic, linear, contextual, dueling and cascading bandit problems.

fine.name: Offline RL with Diffusion Policies
fine.one_line: Offline and offline-to-online reinforcement learning using diffusion, flow-matching and generative policies trained on fixed datasets.

fine.name: Spatial Reasoning in VLMs
fine.one_line: Benchmarks and agentic methods for 3D and embodied spatial reasoning in vision-language models.

fine.name: Deep RL Representations and Multitask
fine.one_line: General deep reinforcement learning methods covering representation learning, multitask, meta, transfer, safe and model-based RL.

fine.name: LLM Pruning and MoE Compression
fine.one_line: Structured pruning, layer removal and mixture-of-experts compression to make large language models cheaper to store and serve.

fine.name: Physical Plausibility in Video Generation
fine.one_line: Evaluating and improving physical consistency, motion realism and world modeling in text-to-video generators.

fine.name: Sparse Autoencoders for Interpretability
fine.one_line: Building, evaluating and stress-testing sparse autoencoders and dictionary learning to extract interpretable features from model activations.

fine.name: Neural Combinatorial Optimization
fine.one_line: Learned solvers, often diffusion or RL based, for routing, SAT, MILP and other constraint satisfaction problems.

fine.name: EEG and Physiological Foundation Models
fine.one_line: Foundation models, benchmarks and datasets for EEG, ECG and other physiological signals in clinical and brain-computer interface settings.

fine.name: Human Motion and Gesture Generation
fine.one_line: Generating, predicting and recognizing human motion, dance, gestures, gait and sign from text, scenes or video.

fine.name: On-Policy Distillation for LLM Reasoning
fine.one_line: Teacher-student distillation where reasoning LLMs learn from teacher feedback on their own generated trajectories.

fine.name: Time Series Forecasting Models
fine.one_line: Forecasting architectures and time series foundation models for multivariate, long-horizon and non-stationary data.

fine.name: GraphRAG and Agentic Search
fine.one_line: Retrieval-augmented generation over knowledge graphs and RL-trained search agents for multi-hop question answering.

fine.name: Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
fine.one_line: Analyzing reasoning traces and reducing overthinking in large reasoning models through pruning, early stopping and search.

fine.name: RL Post-Training Stability for LLMs
fine.one_line: Off-policy corrections, importance ratios, entropy control and credit assignment for stable reinforcement learning post-training of LLMs.

fine.name: Human-AI Collaboration and Oversight
fine.one_line: Position and empirical papers on human oversight, AI-assisted decisions, governance and how AI systems should be evaluated with people.

fine.name: Causal Discovery and Structural Models
fine.one_line: Learning causal graphs and identifying causal effects with structural causal models, interventions and latent variables.

fine.name: Algorithmic Fairness and Group Constraints
fine.one_line: Fair classification and regression, multigroup fairness, fairness audits and fairness-accuracy tradeoffs under sensitive attributes.

fine.name: Robust Regression and Statistical Inference
fine.one_line: Statistical theory for linear regression, covariance estimation and inference under heavy tails, corruption and high dimensions.

fine.name: Tabular Foundation Models
fine.one_line: In-context tabular foundation models such as TabPFN plus benchmarks, robustness, privacy and generation for tabular data.

fine.name: Protein Language Models and Structure
fine.one_line: Protein language models, structure prediction, docking and fitness prediction for biomolecules and drug discovery.

fine.name: Bayesian and Multi-Objective Optimization
fine.one_line: Sample-efficient black-box optimization with Gaussian process surrogates, acquisition functions and multi-objective Pareto search.

fine.name: LLM Behavioral Evaluation and Sycophancy
fine.one_line: Evaluating LLM behaviors such as sycophancy, deception, confirmation bias, moral reasoning, risk attitudes and evaluation awareness.

fine.name: LLM Agent Benchmarks
fine.one_line: Benchmarks and evaluation suites for tool-using, web, GUI and professional-workflow language agents.

fine.name: Speech and Audio Language Models
fine.one_line: Large audio language models, speech recognition, speech enhancement, audio generation and sign language recognition.

fine.name: LLM Hallucination Detection and Mitigation
fine.one_line: Detecting and reducing hallucinations in LLMs and vision-language models using uncertainty, token-level signals and training.

fine.name: Benchmark Validity and Model Selection
fine.one_line: Data-centric studies of benchmarks, model selection, cascades and evaluation pitfalls in how model behavior is measured.

fine.name: Stochastic and Convex Optimization Theory
fine.one_line: Convergence rates for stochastic, decentralized, minimax and nonconvex gradient methods, including heavy-tailed noise and step-size schedules.

fine.name: Neural Network Verification and Backdoors
fine.one_line: Formal verification and certified robustness of neural networks, plus backdoor attacks and provable defenses.

fine.name: Clustering Coresets and Nearest Neighbor Search
fine.one_line: Algorithms and guarantees for coresets, k-means and k-center clustering, metric spaces and approximate nearest neighbor search.

fine.name: Diffusion Theory and Density Estimation
fine.one_line: Theoretical and statistical work on score-based diffusion models, density estimation, denoising and posterior inference for inverse problems.

fine.name: Neural Operators for PDEs
fine.one_line: Neural operator and transformer surrogates that learn to solve partial differential equations for physical simulation and forecasting.

fine.name: Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Diffusion
fine.one_line: Removing unsafe concepts or styles from text-to-image diffusion models, plus adversarial attacks and defenses on vision-language models.

fine.name: Part-Level 3D Asset Generation
fine.one_line: Generating structured, part-decomposed or articulated 3D objects and scenes from images or text.

fine.name: Differentially Private Algorithms and Estimation
fine.one_line: Algorithms and optimal rates for statistical estimation, optimization and data analysis under central or local differential privacy.

fine.name: Learning Equilibria in Games
fine.one_line: Learning dynamics and sample complexity for reaching Nash or correlated equilibria in zero-sum, Markov and potential games.

fine.name: World Models for Agent Planning
fine.one_line: Latent and symbolic world models that let robots and LLM agents predict outcomes and plan actions.

fine.name: AI-Generated Image and Deepfake Detection
fine.one_line: Detecting and localizing AI-generated images, deepfake videos and image tampering for media forensics.

fine.name: Medical Imaging and Pathology Models
fine.one_line: Segmentation, representation learning and vision-language models for radiology, CT and whole-slide pathology images.

fine.name: Model Merging and LoRA Fusion
fine.one_line: Combining fine-tuned models, task vectors or LoRA adapters into a single model without retraining.

fine.name: Vision-Language-Action Robot Policies
fine.one_line: Training, fine-tuning, analysing and evaluating vision-language-action models for robotic manipulation.

fine.name: Flow Matching Theory and Variants
fine.one_line: New formulations, theory and constrained or distilled variants of flow matching and transport-based generative models.

fine.name: End-to-End Autonomous Driving
fine.one_line: End-to-end driving planners, driving VLA models, world models and benchmarks for autonomous vehicles.

fine.name: Domain-Specific Vision Benchmarks for VLMs
fine.one_line: Benchmarks probing multimodal models on specialised imagery such as remote sensing, medical scans, documents, try-on and image quality.

fine.name: Multi-Turn LLM Dialogue and Agent RL
fine.one_line: Reinforcement learning, credit assignment and evaluation for LLMs in multi-turn conversations and interactive agent tasks.

fine.name: Activation Steering of LLMs
fine.one_line: Controlling language model behaviour at inference time by editing internal activations with steering vectors or subspace interventions.

fine.name: Skill Libraries for LLM Agents
fine.one_line: LLM agents that discover, store, reuse and evolve skills to solve long-horizon web, embodied and tool-use tasks.

fine.name: 4D Reconstruction from Monocular Video
fine.one_line: Recovering dynamic 3D geometry, motion and human or object animation from monocular or multi-view video.

fine.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
fine.one_line: Improving faithfulness, efficiency, privacy and knowledge-conflict handling in retrieval-augmented LLM generation.

fine.name: Test-Time Adaptation of CLIP and ViTs
fine.one_line: Adapting, fine-tuning, distilling and robustifying CLIP-style vision-language models and vision transformers under distribution shift.

fine.name: LLM Agent Reliability and Efficiency
fine.one_line: Making LLM agents more reliable, safe and cost-efficient through tool-call decisions, failure prediction, abstention and resource control.

fine.name: LLM Theorem Proving and Formal Math
fine.one_line: Using LLMs for formal theorem proving in Lean, autoformalization, proof grading and math reasoning benchmarks.

fine.name: Text-to-Image Generation and Evaluation
fine.one_line: Improving and evaluating text-to-image models via reward models, compositional control, aesthetics and bias analysis.

fine.name: LLM Multi-Agent Systems
fine.one_line: Designing, training and evaluating teams of collaborating or debating LLM agents, including coordination and orchestration.

fine.name: LLM-Generated GPU Kernels and Systems
fine.one_line: Using LLMs and agents to write and tune CUDA or Triton kernels, plus benchmarks for HPC and ML systems code.

fine.name: Watermarking Generative Model Outputs
fine.one_line: Embedding and detecting watermarks in LLM text, images and audio to trace AI-generated content.

fine.name: Preference Optimization for LLM Alignment
fine.one_line: DPO-style and RLHF objectives, data selection and robustness methods for aligning LLMs with human preferences.

fine.name: Graph Neural Networks and Representation
fine.one_line: GNN architectures, graph contrastive learning, temporal graphs and graph foundation models for node, link and graph tasks.

fine.name: Image Restoration and Inverse Problems
fine.one_line: Denoising, super-resolution, image fusion and plug-and-play or diffusion-based restoration of degraded images.

fine.name: Protein, Antibody and RNA Design
fine.one_line: Generative models and optimization for designing proteins, antibodies, peptides, RNA and DNA sequences.

fine.name: LoRA and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
fine.one_line: Proposes low-rank, sparse, orthogonal and zeroth-order adapter variants and optimizers for fine-tuning large language models with less memory and compute.

fine.name: Online Convex Optimization Regret Bounds
fine.one_line: Derives regret guarantees for online convex and non-convex optimization under delays, switching costs, memory and bandit feedback.

fine.name: RLVR for LLM Reasoning
fine.one_line: Studies reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for reasoning models, focusing on GRPO-style advantage estimation, rollout efficiency and training stability.

fine.name: Recurrent Network Dynamics in Neuroscience
fine.one_line: Analyzes learning and dynamics in low-rank RNNs, Hopfield networks and reservoirs as models of neural circuits and memory.

fine.name: Diffusion Guidance and Sampling
fine.one_line: Improves how diffusion and flow models are guided and sampled, including classifier-free guidance, reward-guided and RL post-training, few-step generation and score-matching analysis.

fine.name: Urban Mobility and Trajectory Generation
fine.one_line: Generates and forecasts vehicle and human trajectories, traffic and spatio-temporal events in cities, including cross-city transfer and benchmarks.

fine.name: Grokking, Memorization and Generalization Theory
fine.one_line: Explains why overparameterized networks generalize, covering grokking, double descent, memorization versus generalization and compression-based bounds.

fine.name: Object Detection and OOD Detection
fine.one_line: Develops open-world, domain-adaptive and long-tailed object detectors and methods for detecting out-of-distribution inputs in vision models.

fine.name: Multi-View Clustering and Person Re-ID
fine.one_line: Learns fused representations across multiple views or modalities for multi-view clustering, incomplete multi-view learning and person or object re-identification.

fine.name: Instruction-Based Image Editing
fine.one_line: Builds datasets, guidance schemes and RL training for editing images from text instructions, exemplars or drag inputs while preserving unedited content.

fine.name: Mechanism Design, Auctions and Social Choice
fine.one_line: Designs and analyzes auctions, pricing, resource allocation, persuasion and voting rules for strategic agents, often with learning-augmented guarantees.

fine.name: Conformal Prediction Coverage Guarantees
fine.one_line: Constructs conformal prediction sets and intervals with marginal, conditional or online coverage guarantees under shift, grouping and multivariate outputs.

fine.name: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction (VGGT)
fine.one_line: Builds and accelerates feed-forward and streaming multi-view geometry transformers for 3D reconstruction, camera pose, depth and panoramic geometry estimation.

fine.name: Learning Dynamical Systems from Data
fine.one_line: Identifies latent and chaotic dynamical systems from observations using Koopman operators, neural ODEs/SDEs, switching models and equation discovery.

fine.name: Speculative Decoding for LLM Inference
fine.one_line: Speeds up LLM generation and serving with draft-and-verify speculative decoding, tree drafting, self-speculation and scheduling.

fine.name: LLM Agent Safety and Prompt Injection
fine.one_line: Benchmarks and defends LLM, computer-use and multi-agent systems against prompt injection, unsafe actions, sabotage and scheming.

fine.name: Quantum Machine Learning
fine.one_line: Applies machine learning to quantum systems and studies quantum neural networks, circuits, kernels, tomography and neural quantum states.

fine.name: Single-Cell and Spatial Transcriptomics Models
fine.one_line: Builds foundation models and generative methods for single-cell gene expression, spatial transcriptomics from histology, perturbation response and genomic sequences.

fine.name: Verified Code and Software Security Benchmarks
fine.one_line: Evaluates LLMs on formally verified code generation, proof writing, vulnerability detection, reverse engineering and cybersecurity tasks.

fine.name: Variational and Simulation-Based Bayesian Inference
fine.one_line: Develops variational inference, neural posterior estimation, Gaussian process and Laplace methods for scalable and robust Bayesian inference.

fine.name: Causal Discovery and Causal Structure Learning
fine.one_line: Recovers causal graphs from observational, interventional or time-series data, including amortized foundation models and LLM-informed priors.

fine.name: Brain Encoding and Neural Recording Analysis
fine.one_line: Models fMRI, EEG and spiking recordings with encoding models, connectivity estimation and neural data tokenizers, plus connectomics benchmarks.

fine.name: Calibration and Prediction-Powered Inference
fine.one_line: Studies post-hoc calibration, multicalibration and prediction-powered inference for reliable estimates and evaluation with few labels.

fine.name: LLM Jailbreak Attacks and Defenses
fine.one_line: Designs, scales and detects jailbreak and red-teaming attacks on LLMs, multimodal and diffusion language models, along with safety defenses.

fine.name: Irregular Time Series and Clinical Signals
fine.one_line: Models irregularly sampled and continuous-time sequences with neural CDEs, state-space models and point processes, often for EHR, ECG, sleep and wearable data.

fine.name: Geometry of Learned Representations
fine.one_line: Analyzes and designs embedding spaces using manifold, hyperbolic, Riemannian, spherical and topological structure for representation learning.

fine.name: Best-Arm Identification in Bandits
fine.one_line: Gives sample-complexity bounds and algorithms for fixed-confidence and fixed-budget best-arm identification and pure exploration in bandits.

fine.name: Diffusion and Flow Policies for RL
fine.one_line: Trains diffusion and flow-matching policies with policy gradients, Q-guidance and offline-to-online RL for multimodal continuous control.

fine.name: Retrieval and Long-Document Benchmarks
fine.one_line: Builds benchmarks and pipelines for retrievers, embedding models, deep search and long-document understanding with evidence grounding.

fine.name: Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
fine.one_line: Builds single models and visual tokenizers that both understand and generate images, including autoregressive and representation-autoencoder approaches.

fine.name: Neural Scaling Laws for Pretraining
fine.one_line: These papers fit, explain and extrapolate power-law scaling laws that relate loss to model size, data and compute, and derive compute-optimal training recipes.

fine.name: Differential Privacy and Membership Inference
fine.one_line: These papers design differentially private training and accounting mechanisms, and audit privacy leakage with membership inference attacks.

fine.name: LLM Agentic Reasoning Strategies
fine.one_line: These papers study how language-model agents choose and combine reasoning strategies for planning, abstraction and scientific problem solving, often with new benchmarks.

fine.name: Muon, Adam and Sign-Based Optimizers
fine.one_line: These papers analyse and design neural-network optimizers such as Muon, Adam, Lion and SignSGD, covering orthogonalized updates, momentum and edge-of-stability dynamics.

fine.name: Language Model Internals and Interpretability
fine.one_line: These papers probe what computations transformers perform internally, such as in-context learning, copying, belief states and hidden reasoning over filler tokens.

fine.name: Coding Agents and SWE Benchmarks
fine.one_line: These papers benchmark and train LLM coding agents on repository-level software engineering, long-horizon development and debugging tasks.

fine.name: Shapley Values and Feature Attribution
fine.one_line: These papers develop and critique post-hoc explanation methods such as Shapley values, integrated gradients and causal attributions for model predictions.

fine.name: PAC Learning and Sample Complexity
fine.one_line: These papers prove sample-complexity and lower bounds for PAC, online and agnostic learning, especially of halfspaces and concept classes with VC or Littlestone dimension.

fine.name: Chemical Reactions and Interatomic Potentials
fine.one_line: These papers build models and benchmarks for chemistry tasks such as reaction prediction, retrosynthesis, mass-spectrometry retrieval and machine-learned interatomic potentials.

fine.name: Autoregressive Long Video Generation
fine.one_line: These papers extend video diffusion models to long or streaming generation with autoregressive rollout, memory for consistency, and distillation for real-time speed.

fine.name: Graph and Hypergraph Generation
fine.one_line: These papers propose diffusion, flow-matching, autoencoder and sequence models that generate graphs and hypergraphs at scale.

fine.name: 3D Molecule and Material Generation
fine.one_line: These papers generate 3D molecules, crystals, proteins and materials with equivariant diffusion, flow and autoregressive models, including structure-based drug design.

fine.name: Video Temporal Grounding and Segmentation
fine.one_line: These papers localize actions, moments and objects in time and space in video, covering temporal grounding, video object segmentation and video reasoning segmentation.

fine.name: Deep Network Theory and Learning Dynamics
fine.one_line: These papers analyse ReLU and residual networks theoretically, covering implicit bias, incremental learning, parameter symmetries, identifiability and feature learning.

fine.name: Neural PDE Solvers and PINNs
fine.one_line: These papers solve partial differential equations with physics-informed networks, neural surrogates, PDE foundation models and generative inverse solvers.

fine.name: 3D Scene Understanding with VLMs
fine.one_line: These papers ground language in 3D scenes for open-vocabulary understanding, spatial reasoning, affordances and localization using point clouds, multi-view images and 3D-LLMs.

fine.name: Vision-Language Alignment and CLIP
fine.one_line: These papers improve image-text alignment in CLIP-style and vision-language models for compositional understanding, long captions and image retrieval.

fine.name: Long-Video Understanding with MLLMs
fine.one_line: These papers help multimodal LLMs answer questions over long and streaming videos via frame selection, token allocation, KV-cache memory and agentic pipelines.

fine.name: LLM Personas, Sycophancy and Cultural Bias
fine.one_line: These papers measure how LLMs simulate personas and opinions and how they show sycophancy, stereotypes and cultural or value biases.

fine.name: Machine Unlearning in LLMs
fine.one_line: These papers remove the influence of specific training data from models, mainly LLMs, while preserving utility and resisting relearning.

fine.name: Brain Decoding from fMRI, MEG, ECoG
fine.one_line: These papers decode speech, images and intentions from brain recordings and build brain foundation models and datasets for brain-computer interfaces.

fine.name: Offline and In-Context Reinforcement Learning
fine.one_line: These papers learn and adapt policies from fixed datasets, behavior foundation models and in-context RL, including safe offline RL and post-training policy steering.

fine.name: Low-Bit LLM Quantization
fine.one_line: These papers compress LLM weights and activations to low bit-widths through post-training quantization, quantization-aware training and mixed-precision search.

fine.name: Constrained and Robust MDPs
fine.one_line: These papers give provable algorithms for constrained, chance-constrained and robust Markov decision processes, often via primal-dual policy optimization.

fine.name: LLMs for Optimization Modeling and Algorithm Design
fine.one_line: These papers use LLMs, often with evolutionary search, to formulate optimization models, discover algorithms and generate engineering or combinatorial code, with benchmarks for each.

fine.name: Performative Prediction and Decision-Focused Learning
fine.one_line: These papers study predictions that feed into decisions, including performative prediction, predict-then-optimize, recalibration and learning-augmented algorithms.

fine.name: Sequential and Generative Recommendation
fine.one_line: These papers model user preferences for sequential, multimodal and generative recommendation, increasingly with LLMs and diffusion models.

fine.name: LiDAR and Radar Perception for Driving
fine.one_line: These papers handle LiDAR, radar and multi-sensor data for localization, point-cloud registration, scene flow and HD map construction in driving and UAV settings.

fine.name: Spiking Neural Networks
fine.one_line: These papers train and analyse spiking neural networks for energy-efficient neuromorphic computing, using learnable delays, neuron models and plasticity rules.

fine.name: Clinical LLMs and Medical Benchmarks
fine.one_line: These papers evaluate and build LLM agents for clinical reasoning, EHR tasks, medical QA and report generation, along with medical benchmarks.

broad.name: LLM Agents
broad.one_line: Benchmarks, memory, skills, safety, multi-agent coordination and multi-turn training for tool-using and coding LLM agents, plus human oversight of AI decisions.

broad.name: 3D Vision & Perception
broad.one_line: Feed-forward and Gaussian-splatting 3D reconstruction, 3D scene grounding, LiDAR perception, medical imaging, restoration, anomaly and OOD detection, and image forensics.

broad.name: LLM Behavior & Safety
broad.one_line: Interpretability, evaluation, sycophancy, hallucination, jailbreaks, unlearning, knowledge editing, steering and watermarking of language models, plus diffusion LMs, audio LMs and recommendation.

broad.name: Optimization & Statistics
broad.one_line: Optimizer design such as Muon and Adam, stochastic and convex convergence theory, robust regression and Bayesian optimization.

broad.name: Graph Learning
broad.one_line: Graph neural network architectures, graph foundation models and generative models for graphs and hypergraphs.

broad.name: DL Theory & Neuroscience
broad.one_line: Learning dynamics and generalization theory, representation geometry, attribution and sparse autoencoders, plus brain decoding, spiking networks, quantum ML, verification and neural combinatorial optimization.

broad.name: Robotics & Embodied AI
broad.one_line: Vision-language-action policies, dexterous and humanoid manipulation, autonomous driving, world models for planning and embodied spatial reasoning.

broad.name: Vision-Language Models
broad.one_line: Visual reasoning, image-text alignment, multimodal fusion, domain-specific benchmarks and test-time adaptation for vision-language models.

broad.name: LLM Reasoning & Retrieval
broad.one_line: Efficient chain-of-thought, agentic reasoning, formal math and verified code, LLM-driven optimization modeling, clinical reasoning and retrieval-augmented generation.

broad.name: Reinforcement Learning
broad.one_line: Deep, offline, multi-agent, goal-conditioned and constrained RL, generative policies and convergence theory for MDPs.

broad.name: Video Generation & Understanding
broad.one_line: Long and controllable video generation, physical plausibility, long-video QA, temporal grounding and human motion generation.

broad.name: Time Series & Forecasting
broad.one_line: Time series forecasting models, irregular and continuous-time sequences, weather and climate prediction, and urban mobility.

broad.name: Trustworthy & Statistical ML
broad.one_line: Federated learning, differential privacy, fairness, conformal prediction, calibration, causal effect estimation, noisy labels, PAC theory, clustering and tabular foundation models.

broad.name: LLM Post-Training
broad.one_line: RL with verifiable rewards, preference optimization, reward models, on-policy distillation and continual learning for language models.

broad.name: PDEs & Dynamical Systems
broad.one_line: Neural operators, physics-informed networks and data-driven identification of dynamical systems.

broad.name: Image & 3D Generation
broad.one_line: Text-to-image generation and evaluation, efficient high-resolution diffusion, image editing, unified multimodal models, part-level 3D assets and concept erasure.

broad.name: Bandits, Games & Mechanisms
broad.one_line: Bandit regret and best-arm identification, online convex optimization, equilibrium learning in games, and mechanism design and social choice.

broad.name: Diffusion, Flows & Inference
broad.one_line: Diffusion guidance and sampling, flow matching, diffusion theory, optimal transport, and variational and simulation-based Bayesian inference.

broad.name: Efficient LLMs & Architectures
broad.one_line: Transformer theory, sparse attention, KV cache, quantization, pruning, speculative decoding, PEFT, model merging, scaling laws and LLM-written GPU kernels.

broad.name: Biomolecules & Causal Discovery
